summary: Kept by esv::inventory::SummoningSystem (ProcessReequipUpdates, game bg3.exe+0x35087A0 ~ Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xF2AB60): remembers what was unequipped when a summoned item took an equipment slot, so it can be re-equipped when the summon goes away. A HashMap<EntityHandle, Array<esv::inventory::UnequippedEntry>> (macOS names: ls::HashMap<ls::ID<ecs::EntityHandleTraits>, ls::DynamicArray<esv::inventory::UnequippedEntry>>). Saved (model game.inventory.v0.ReequipStackComponent, 16 bytes; member names not in the macOS symbols). Never seen alive. Registry total 64 (server row).

fields.name: Slot
fields.evidence: Game bg3.exe+0x35087A0 line 435 `if (*local_3b8 != 0x16)` (0x16 = no slot) and passes the byte as the slot to eoc::equipment::GetEquipmentEntityInSlot; Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xF2AB60 line ~538 the same. Equipment slot enum, 1 byte.

fields.name: Item
fields.evidence: game line 436 `local_3d0 = pbVar16 + -0x20` (entry +8) is looked up as an entity and its owner compared with the stack's entity; the entry is filled from the 0x38-byte ReequipStackUpdate (lines 576-586, qword copies to +0/+8).

fields.name: Slot2
fields.evidence: game line 448 `if (local_3b8[0x10] != 0x16)` - a second slot, same 0x16 = none.

fields.name: Item2
fields.evidence: game line 449 `local_3d0 = local_3b8 + 0x18` - the second entity, looked up like +8.

fields.name: Processed
fields.evidence: game line 431 `pbVar16[-8] = 1` (entry +0x20) for every entry visited; Toolkit removes entries whose `*(char *)(entry + 0x20) != 0` (line ~798) with the DynamicArray<esv::inventory::UnequippedEntry> remover.

fields.name: Entries
fields.evidence: Storage registration bg3.exe+0x2702560: size 0x40, destructor bg3.exe+0x591CF0 (frees the value array at +0x30, then the 48-byte HashSet of keys via bg3.exe+0x582AD0). Game bg3.exe+0x35087A0 walks it as a HashMap: keys at +0x20 with count at +0x2C, values at +0x30 with stride 0x10 (`lVar15 * 0x10 + plVar21[6]`), each value an Array of 0x28-byte entries. Key and value types from the macOS template name ls::HashMap<ls::ID<ecs::EntityHandleTraits>, ls::DynamicArray<esv::inventory::UnequippedEntry>>.
